# A compact Phrase cheat sheet for model prompts
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #104, sha256:c03b84255d66416c69506446c4e58ddf84357c4a38938edf608ba9a039434517). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** docs (thin slice; code, data and docs stay separate)
- **Milestone:** Measure first: does Phrase beat plain C# on tokens and attempts at an equal or better pass rate?
- **Source:** Decider D52 (2026-10-27): plain C# costs about 215 to 230 tokens per task while the Phrase docs-in-context arm charges about 4850 documentation tokens per attempt, so on the frozen token bar (D32) Phrase cannot win with the full documentation. D32 and D66 allow a compact cheat sheet only if it is committed and its hash recorded BEFORE the first scored row; this card and card 105 do that before card 101 runs.
- **Depends on:** 100
- **Story:** As Ari, I want a one-page cheat sheet of Phrase that a model can read in a few hundred tokens, so that a new user or model can write a working phrase without reading the whole grammar.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the cheat sheet file docs/CHEATSHEET.md, When its size is estimated with the benchmark's own token estimator, Then it is at most 700 estimated tokens (the check fails above that)
  2. Given the reference solutions and starting code of the eight head-to-head development tasks and orders.phrase, When every keyword they use is looked up, Then each keyword and each core type they use appears in the cheat sheet with one short example (a test names any missing one)
  3. Given a Phrase arm run with --custom-docs pointing at a docs root whose docs/GRAMMAR.md is the cheat sheet, When the row is stored, Then it records docs-in-context-custom and the sha256 of the sheet and charges its tokens on every attempt (a test with a fake model command)

## Context

- Docs card: no emitter or language change. The cheat sheet must not leak any holdout content (the holdouts are sealed) and must not contain the answers to the development tasks.
- Frozen bar unchanged (D32); the sheet is charged like any documentation (D66). Existing modes and rows stay as they are.
